Path: ② the capabilities an end user meets in the app — the zh-CN interface | 缺项 | P3

## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:i18n` · `pm:queue`. Direction as the body proposes

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T17:24Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in the zh-CN locale (`packages/i18n/src/locales`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: a Studio or console surface in objectui. Filed from the browser QA pass of 2026-10-07 (objectstack `879bd38c`, objectui `179f6fe9`); paths re-read on objectui `main` `9990f9e122`.

- **Why p3:** wrong and missing strings, no wrong behaviour.
- **Direction:**
  - use 数据 / 自动化 / 界面 (the zh tab labels already in use) wherever zh strings say 支柱
  - add the missing timezone keys to every locale that lacks them
- `Clause-②: no`. Patch changeset in objectui.

Claim: PM loop round 8
Session: `session_01DrKzdPdyLLBW3qpZ4vtk7z`
Account: `huangyiirene`
Branch: `claude/issue-11801-zh-pillar-timezone-labels`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-11801`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface (line numbers on `5aa7f55`):
- **Item 1, the zh pillar names:** the ZH rows of `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` that say 支柱 or leave a pillar name in English inside Chinese text. Examples: `engine.studio.nav.noObjects` (`:5992`) and `engine.studio.if.objectHintPost` (`:6010`). Values only, in the zh tab labels already in use (数据 / 自动化 / 界面). The dev enumerates every such row with a grep and names each one.
- **Item 2, the timezone settings labels:** measure first, then edit only on a `Clause-②: no` route.
  - `apps/console/src/pages/settings/useSettingsLabel.ts`: `resolve()`'s probing (about `:70`–`:85`), only if the ~25 "Missing translation" warnings come from it probing namespaces that hold no tree for this settings namespace.
  - `apps/console/src/pages/settings/WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.tsx`: only if the prompt renders its help text itself.
- The tests beside these, and `.changeset/11801-*.md`.

⛔ Not on it:
- **Seat 3's objectui#11782** (claim `6050311093`): `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`'s *Label* input and its `designer.field.*` rows.
- **`packages/i18n/**`.** `en.ts` ends in `as const` and exports `TranslationKeys = typeof en`, so a new key there widens a published type. That is `Clause-②: yes`.
- **objectstack's settings manifest and its translation metadata,** the server side of `TranslationData.settings.<namespace>`. That is another repository.

If item 2's keys can only go into `packages/i18n` or into objectstack, the dev stops that item and reports `needs_decision` with the four-axis analysis. Item 1 then lands alone as `Refs #11801 (item 1)`. Any other file outside this list: the dev reports it before opening the PR (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over these paths: no path-derived mandate; default tier)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui app-shell Studio and console settings: zh strings translate "pillar" as 支柱 and leave the pillar names in English, and the workspace-timezone prompt logs ~25 missing-translation warnings and shows developer help text | item 1: none, the zh tab labels already exist; item 2: measured first, because the settings label convention reads TranslationData.settings.<namespace>, which may be the server's | every zh-CN author in Studio, and every administrator at an app's first open, measured by the filer in the 2026-10-07 QA pass`
Thread-read: 6043149043
Serial constraints cleared: `none` blocking.
- **`area:i18n` in flight:** seat 3's objectui#11782 (claim `6050311093`). Its surface is `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`'s Label input and new `designer.field.*` rows. This card edits only existing ZH rows elsewhere in `i18n.ts`, plus console settings files, so the two are disjoint.
- **Other in-flight cards on `i18n.ts`** (objectui#11786, #11802, #11823 and others) add rows under their own prefixes. This card changes values of existing rows, so whichever lands second merges `main`.
- **Open objectui PRs:** objectui#11850, #11851, #11852 and #11853. None touches `apps/console/src/pages/settings/` or `packages/i18n/`. Read 2026-10-08T02:07Z.
- **This seat:** dispatch is parallel, `batch` 3, on the maintainer's word in this session's chat: 「改为并行派发，batch 3」, and 「继续派发」 today.
  - The batch counts working devs.
  - Working with this card: objectui#11823's dev and objectui#11802's.

Why `Clause-②: no`: item 1 changes values of app-shell's unexported `ENGINE_STRINGS`. Item 2 may only take a route that adds no published key and no accepted input; `packages/i18n` and objectstack are fenced off above, and the dev stops if the fix needs either.
